outputs.issues: The statement is present but not formatted per journal requirements. Problems: 1) Datasets are not listed as separate bullet points (single paragraph used). 2) The SRA deposit (Barcode sequencing data: Sequence Read Archive PRJNA1368999) lacks a resolvable link (e.g. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA1368999 or identifiers.org/bioproject:PRJNA1368999). 3) The GitHub code entry should be a separate bullet with repository name and ideally a DOI or release tag (currently only a URL in the paragraph). Please provide each dataset on its own bullet including: measurement type, repository name/acronym, accession/DOI, and a resolvable URL.
